propositions: The LLM re-review trigger word 'recheck-review' collides with the external CI ChatOps 'recheck' matcher in gerrit_to_platform.ini.template, causing substring-based comment matching to dispatch CI Verified workflow unintentionally.
Bot-posted reply texts (_ACCEPTED_MESSAGE, _refusal_message) embed the retired trigger word verbatim, re-dispatching CI from the bot's own Gerrit comments.
Comments containing the old trigger word must be rejected with a refusal reply naming the new trigger 'rerun-llm-review', without enqueuing a review or writing a label.
The new trigger token 'rerun-llm-review' shares no substring with any [mapping "comment-added"] key in the ini template in either direction.

All contributor-facing documentation and bot reply texts must be scrubbed of the retired word and updated to the new trigger; the old word survives only in retrigger.py detector logic and tests exercising the refusal branch.
